text.tspan: Penalty Link: Art. 9 Decree 12/2022 (20M - 25M VND fine)
Requesting employees to provide cash or property
Forcing employees to perform labor contracts to
pay off debts to the employer.
The probationary period shall be agreed upon by
both parties based on job complexity, but only once
No more than 60 days for jobs
requiring a college degree or higher
